note: Additional automatic denials for MAIE workforce work. Merge into the automatic_denials array of config/policies/captains-gate.json. These are action names: CaptainsGate denies any request whose `action` field matches.

denial_rationale.individual_performance_inference: Deriving individual performance signal from demand or workload data converts an operating model diagnostic into an unreviewed appraisal instrument. The estate's human gate names performance decisions as non-delegable.
denial_rationale.individual_employee_identification: Re-identifying individuals from aggregated unit data defeats the aggregation control that keeps MAIE inside its confidential ceiling.
denial_rationale.unaggregated_er_case_ingestion: Employee relations case detail at individual level exceeds the MAIE data ceiling. Raising the ceiling is a deliberate governance decision, not a side effect of a convenient data feed.
denial_rationale.headcount_reduction_directive: The system may describe demand and recommend a coverage model. It may not issue an employment-reducing instruction. That decision belongs to an accountable human and, in Singapore, carries statutory and MOM notification consequences.
denial_rationale.coverage_recommendation_without_route_ce: A recommendation produced by an uncertified model route has no evidence trail behind its model selection, which breaks evidence-before-trust at the point where the output is most consequential.

estate_gate_alignment.note: These denials operationalise the estate's declared human gate. The gate names the categories; the denials name the actions that would breach them.
